output.question: Why did EU revenue drop in week 41?
output.summary: EU net revenue dropped in week 41: Cancelled orders with reason 'delivery_delay' on carrier NordExpress rose from €159 in week 40 to €3,347 in week 41, which explains 106.0% of the €3,007 drop in net revenue [E4]. NordExpress shipments were late (three or more days) in 91.7% of cases in week 41 versus 11.9% in the four prior weeks, and 37 of 42 affected orders had a late shipment [E5]. Support tickets rose to 52 in week 41 (four-week mean 14), and 50 of them (96.2%) are tied to NordExpress orders [E6]

evidence.description: Weekly net revenue, gross order value and cancellations (EU, weeks 37-41)
evidence.query_text: csv:orders where iso_year=2026 and iso_week>=37 and iso_week<=41 and region='EU' group_by(iso_week,status) sum(order_value_eur) count(order_id) order_by(iso_week asc,status asc)

evidence.description: Net revenue change by category (week 41 vs prior week)
evidence.query_text: csv:orders where iso_year=2026 and iso_week>=40 and iso_week<=41 and region='EU' group_by(iso_week,category,status) sum(order_value_eur) limit 5000

evidence.description: Net revenue change by country (week 41 vs prior week)
evidence.query_text: csv:orders where iso_year=2026 and iso_week>=40 and iso_week<=41 and region='EU' group_by(iso_week,country,status) sum(order_value_eur) limit 5000

evidence.description: Cancelled orders by carrier and reason (week 41 vs prior week)
evidence.query_text: csv:orders where iso_year=2026 and iso_week>=40 and iso_week<=41 and region='EU' and status='cancelled' select(order_id,iso_week,carrier,cancel_reason,order_value_eur) order_by(order_value_eur desc) limit 5000

evidence.description: Shipment delays by carrier (weeks 37-42) joined to cancelled orders
evidence.query_text: csv:shipments where ship_iso_year=2026 and ship_iso_week>=37 and ship_iso_week<=42 and region='EU' select(shipment_id,order_id,carrier,ship_iso_week,delay_days) limit 5000

evidence.description: Support tickets (weeks 37-41) joined to NordExpress orders
evidence.query_text: csv:tickets where iso_year=2026 and iso_week>=37 and iso_week<=41 and region='EU' select(ticket_id,iso_week,category,order_id) limit 5000
